title: [finding] the installed-spec-pin claim rots in ~53 more places than objectui#8897 measured — its probe was version-literal on 17.3.0 and blind to the 17.2.0 cohort by construction
body:
Filed from objectui#8897 (dev seat, session `session_01611D6ZaRaMmwTNQmSbk8MH`), which measured this while widening that card's probe. ⛔ Unassigned; grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

## The reading

objectui#8897 fixed the statements that said the installed `@objectstack/spec` pin **is 17.3.0**. Its triage probe was version-literal on `17.3.0` and therefore blind, by construction, to the same sentence written about an **earlier** pin. Re-running the probe by predicate instead of by version string finds a much larger population.

Predicate: a line naming a version `17.0.x`–`17.3.x` **and** carrying a present-tense installed-ness marker (`installed`, `this repo's pin`, `the pin is`, `pinned`, `at that pin`), excluding semver ranges and excluding every `CHANGELOG`.

Measured on `origin/main` at the objectui#8897 branch point (`4fa0eb9c4`), with the branch's own two new prose lines subtracted:

    ~53 sites · 46 files · 13 packages

The installed artifact is **17.4.0** — verified twice, from `pnpm-lock.yaml` (`@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`, two snapshot keys) and from the resolved tree (`packages/app-shell/node_modules/@objectstack/spec/package.json` reports `17.4.0`).

Representative sites, one per package, all present-tense:

- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` — "Measured against the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.2.0 (ESM build)", and two more in the same file
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` — "measured on the installed pin, 17.2.0"
- `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` — "installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.2.0: SelectOptionSchema is strict"
- `packages/test-support/src/spec-zod-wrappers.ts` — "Measured against the installed pin (`zod@4.4.3`, `@objectstack/spec@17.2.0`)"
- `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx` and `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` — "⏳ Interim, and it self-expires: the pin is still `@objectstack/spec` 17.2.0" — ⭐ two notes that declare themselves self-expiring on a pin bump that has since happened TWICE
- `scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs` — "both of those answer from the INSTALLED tree, which is 17.2.0"
- `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — "measured against the installed 17.0.0"

## Why this is class (b) and not tidying

Same judgement objectui#8897 was graded on: a **declared, version-stamped measurement contradicted by the artifact it names**. The hazard is agent-specific and already recorded in `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`'s own header — an agent reads the comment, takes it as ground truth, and builds on it; a wrong canonical claim is a planted premise for the next session, not stale documentation.

## ⛔ The distinction that must survive triage

Two classes, only one broken — objectui#8897's triage established this and it applies unchanged here:

- **"when it changed"** — "17.3.0 **made** `reference` a hard requirement", "43 keys **at** 17.3.0", "New in 17.3.0" — permanently true, ⛔ never touch. A probe matching a bare version string will "fix" these too, and that rewrites history into a falsehood. The predicate above deliberately requires an installed-ness marker for exactly this reason.
- **"what is installed"** — the subject.

⛔ No `CHANGELOG` occurrence, and (this seat's added carve-out) ⛔ no `.changeset/*.md` occurrence: a pending changeset becomes a CHANGELOG entry verbatim, so it is a dated record of the change it describes, not a claim about today.

## ⚠️ What this is NOT, and the cost that makes it a card

⛔ **Not a find-and-replace of `17.2.0` to `17.4.0`.** Each site states a MEASURED FACT about a schema, and each fact has to be re-measured against 17.4.0 before its stamp moves — otherwise the repair plants a fresh false premise, which is strictly worse than the stale one it replaces. objectui#8897 did exactly this for its own six sites: every claim it re-stamped was re-parsed against the installed artifact first, with controls, and one of them (`SchemaForm.groupSectionReachability-8725`) needed a purpose-written probe because the file's own assertions did not cover the prose claim.

⇒ The unit of work is one measurement per site, not one edit per site. Sizing and lane are triage's; this card only establishes that the population is ~53 and that a bare string sweep is the wrong instrument for it.

## The durable alternative worth ruling on

objectui#8897 took a third route at two of its sites rather than re-stamping: it **deleted the installed-pin claim** and left the measurement to the assertion that re-parses the schema on every run. A prose sentence cannot notice a pin bump; a `safeParse` in a test can, and this tree already has the tripwire idiom for it. Whether that route is preferred tree-wide, or only where an assertion already exists, is a decision this card does not make.

## Related

objectui#8897 (the 17.3.0 half, fixed) · objectui#8772 (pin to 17.4.0) · objectui#7122 (pin to 17.3.0 — the bump that made most of this population false) · objectui#8875 (same shape one axis over: a cross-file citation that nothing tells the reader has moved)
